@graph.headline: Help Scout Review: Features, Limits and Fit
@graph.description: Read this Help Scout review of shared Inbox, Docs, Beacon, AI, pricing, migration limits, strengths and trade-offs before choosing a support platform.

mainEntity.name: Is Help Scout good for a small business?

acceptedAnswer.text: It can suit a small business that wants a shared Inbox and help center. Check the Free plan's 100-contact monthly limit and the paid seat price against your real support volume.

mainEntity.name: Does Help Scout have a free plan?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. The official Free plan includes up to five users, one Inbox, one Docs site and 100 contacts per monthly cycle. Checked November 22, 2026. Free plan details.
It offers agent-side AI features and Scout through Beacon. Envoy is billed by successful AI resolution after the trial. New MCP connections are read-only.

It can replace some email-first support workflows, but the two products have different levels of ticketing and service operations. Compare routing, custom fields, channels, migration needs and total seat cost before moving.

mainEntity.name: Can I export all Help Scout data?

acceptedAnswer.text: Not through one report export. Reports can be exported to CSV or XLSX, but conversation thread contents are excluded. The Inbox API and Docs API provide other data export paths. See the official export options.
